newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht up offshore, interbank rate eases late.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht up offshore, interbank rate eases late.

text.p: The Thai baht was higher in the offshore market in late Monday trade on strong demand for baht and rising swap premiums, dealers said.
The baht rose to 24.250/24.300 to the dollar late in the offshore market from 24.300/24.400 in early morning trade.
A Singapore-based dealer said the coming maturity of one-month forward contracts since the latest attack on the baht in mid-May also triggered dollar selling for baht in the spot market.
The one-month baht/dollar swap premium firmed to 100/110 satangs per dollar late in offshore market from 90/110 in early morning.
In domestic market, the baht eased to 25.835/25.845 late from 25.830/25.840 earlier on strong commercial demand for dollar, dealers said.
In the onshore market, the one-month swap premium was quoted at 15.00/18.00 satangs from 14.00/19.00 in the morning.
The overnight interbank rate eased to 12.50/12.75 percent late from 13.13.50/14.00 on lower demand for funds, dealers said.
